base_skip_to_content: Visually hidden skip link at the very top of every page; keyboard users press it to jump past the navigation.
docs_banner_outdated: Banner at the top of a translated docs page when the English source changed after the translation; followed by two links (English page, GitHub diff).
docs_banner_read_english: Link in the outdated-translation banner that opens the English version of the same docs page.
docs_banner_see_changes: Link in the outdated-translation banner that opens the GitHub diff of the English source since the translation.
docs_banner_untranslated: Banner above a docs page that has no translation; the page body below is shown in English on purpose.
docs_meta_description: Meta description of a docs page when the page has none of its own; {title} is the page title.
docs_page_title: Browser tab title of a docs page; {title} is the page title, then the site section name.
footer_changelog: Footer link to the changelog page, in the Product column.
footer_code_signing: Footer legal link to the code signing policy page.
footer_config_reference: Footer link to the atlas.yaml configuration reference docs page, in the Docs column; atlas.yaml is a file name and stays as is.
footer_desktop: Footer link to the Atlas Desktop docs page, in the Docs column; Desktop is the app's product name.
footer_docs: Heading of the footer column that links to documentation pages; also the accessible name of that nav.
footer_download: Footer link to the download page, in the Product column.
footer_elsewhere: Heading of the footer column with outside links (GitHub, CodeAtlas, llms.txt); also the accessible name of that nav.
footer_getting_started: Footer link to the getting started docs page, in the Product column.
footer_license: Footer legal line stating the open source licenses; the dot is a separator.
footer_privacy: Footer legal link to the privacy policy page.
footer_product: Heading of the footer column with product links (download, getting started, changelog, releases); also the accessible name of that nav.
footer_releases: Footer link to the GitHub releases page, in the Product column.
footer_troubleshooting: Footer link to the troubleshooting docs page, in the Docs column.
nav_changelog: Top navigation link to the changelog page.
nav_docs: Top navigation link to the documentation (opens the getting started page).
nav_download: Short call-to-action button in the top bar that opens the download page.
nav_download_atlas: Full-width download button at the bottom of the phone menu sheet; opens the download page.
nav_getting_started: Link in the phone menu sheet to the getting started docs page.
nav_home_label: Accessible name of the logo link in the top bar; it goes to the home page.
nav_idea: Link in the phone menu sheet that scrolls to the atlas.yaml section of the landing page.
nav_language_switch: Visible text of the language switch link in the top bar. It names the OTHER language, written in that language, so it reads Portuguese on English pages and English on Portuguese pages.
nav_main_label: Accessible name of the main navigation landmark in the top bar.
nav_menu_close: Accessible name of the burger button while the phone menu sheet is open.
nav_menu_label: Accessible name of the navigation landmark inside the phone menu sheet.
nav_menu_open: Accessible name of the burger button while the phone menu sheet is closed.
not_found_docs: Secondary button on the 404 page that opens the docs.
not_found_heading: Large heading of the 404 page; playful, it says the page is not on the map.
not_found_home: Primary button on the 404 page that goes back to the home page; stack refers to the dev stack Atlas runs.
not_found_text: Paragraph under the 404 heading explaining the link is old or the page never existed, and pointing to the docs search.
not_found_title: Browser tab title of the 404 page.
